description: Browser Agent must NOT fire when a snippet answer suffices. A market-data question about typical service costs lives in Web Agent's lane (Tavily search returns the price range as a snippet). Browser Agent is tool of last resort; the orchestrator's routing prompt is explicit about preferring Web Agent for snippet-level questions. This case catches a regression where the prompt grows lazy and routes everything to Browser Agent when Web Agent would do.

input.user_message: What's a typical service-call cost for a clogged drain in residential plumbing?

web_search.answer: Clogged drain service calls typically run $100-$300 in most US markets.

sources.title: HomeAdvisor — Drain cleaning cost guide
sources.snippet: Average residential drain cleaning service calls run $100 to $300 depending on the location of the clog and whether the plumber needs to use a snake.
